steps.title: Thaw and start Sf9 culture
steps.instruction: Thaw 1–2 mL frozen Sf9 cells in a 37 °C water bath, resuspend in 10 mL Sf‑900 III medium, spin at 125 × g for 5 min, remove supernatant, resuspend in 10 mL fresh Sf‑900 III, transfer to a 250 mL flask, add 15 mL Sf‑900 III (total 25 mL), incubate at 27 °C, 125 rpm shaking.

steps.title: Expand Sf9 culture to target density
steps.instruction: Monitor cell density daily with a hemocytometer; when density reaches 3.0–3.5 × 10⁶ cells/mL (≈24–48 h), split by adding Sf‑900 III medium to obtain a new 20 mL culture at 0.7 × 10⁶ cells/mL, incubate at 27 °C, 125 rpm. Repeat split 2–3 times until doubling time ≈24 h. Maintain cultures at 0.5–3.5 × 10⁶ cells/mL in 250 mL flasks for later scaling.

steps.title: Transform DH10Bac with P2X7 construct
steps.instruction: Mix 25 µL DH10Bac competent cells with 100–250 ng pNGFP‑FB3[P2X7] on ice 30 min, heat‑shock 45 s at 42 °C, ice 2 min, add 500 µL SOC, shake 225 rpm at 37 °C for 4 h, centrifuge 20,000 × g 1 min, plate on LB‑Bac agar (add ~50 µL SOC if needed), incubate 2 days at 37 °C.

steps.title: Isolate bacmid DNA from white colony
steps.instruction: Pick a white colony, inoculate 8 mL LB‑Bac broth, grow overnight at 225 rpm, 37 °C; harvest cells 2,500 × g 10 min, resuspend pellet in 200 µL Solution 1 (Plasmid Mini Kit), add 200 µL Solution 2, mix by flipping, add 270 µL Solution 3, mix, centrifuge 20,000 × g 10 min, keep supernatant, add 700 µL phenol‑chloroform, vortex, centrifuge 20,000 × g 2 min, transfer upper phase, add 700 µL chloroform, vortex, centrifuge 20,000 × g 2 min, transfer upper phase to a 2 mL tube, add 1.4 mL 100 % ethanol, vortex, chill –20 °C 15 min, centrifuge 20,000 × g 15 min at 4 °C, rinse pellet with 1 mL 70 % ethanol, aspirate, dry in hood 30 min, resuspend in 50 µL sterile Milli‑Q water, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Transfect Sf9 for P1 virus production
steps.instruction: Plate Sf9 cells at 0.4 × 10⁶ cells per well in a 6‑well plate, incubate 27 °C 1 h; meanwhile mix 5 µL bacmid DNA, 10 µL polyethylenimine solution (recipe), and 100 µL Sf‑900 III medium, incubate 15 min at room temperature, add dropwise to wells, incubate 27 °C 6–7 days; observe GFP fluorescence at day 7, collect supernatant (P1 virus), filter through 0.22 µm filter, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Amplify virus to P2 stock
steps.instruction: Inoculate 200 mL Sf9 culture at 1.0 × 10⁶ cells/mL with 100 µL P1 virus, shake 125 rpm at 27 °C for 3 days, harvest media by centrifugation 2,500 × g 10 min, filter supernatant through 0.22 µm filter to obtain P2 virus, store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Large‑scale expression of P2X7
steps.instruction: Grow 1 L Sf9 culture at 0.5 × 10⁶ cells/mL for 3 days at 125 rpm, 27 °C; split into 6 L total (maintain 0.5 × 10⁶ cells/mL); add 7.5 mL/L penicillin‑streptomycin (100× stock), continue 3 days at 27 °C, 125 rpm; when density reaches 4.0 × 10⁶ cells/mL, infect with 30 mL/L P2 virus, culture 27 °C 24 h, then shift to 18 °C for an additional 48 h before harvest.

steps.title: Harvest cells and resuspend
steps.instruction: Transfer GFP‑P2X7 cells to 1 L centrifuge bottles, spin 2,000 × g 10 min (JS‑4.2 rotor), decant media, resuspend each bottle with ~20 mL resuspension buffer (recipe), combine suspensions into a 250 mL bottle, spin 3,800 × g 10 min (JA‑14 rotor), remove buffer, resuspend pellet in 200 mL fresh resuspension buffer. All steps performed on ice or at 4 °C.

steps.title: Cell disruption by nitrogen cavitation
steps.instruction: Load the 200 mL cell suspension into a nitrogen cavitation vessel, pressurize to 600 psi, incubate 20 min at 4 °C, release pressure, collect lysate.

steps.title: Clarify lysate and collect membranes
steps.instruction: Centrifuge lysate 12,700 × g 10 min (JA‑14 rotor) to remove debris, transfer supernatant to three 70 mL ultracentrifuge tubes, balance with resuspension buffer to the shoulder, ultracentrifuge 185,000 × g 1 h (Ti‑45 rotor), discard supernatant, resuspend membrane pellet in 2 mL PBS per tube.

steps.title: Homogenize membrane fraction
steps.instruction: Combine the three membrane suspensions (total 8–12 mL) in a Dounce homogenizer, set speed to ~900 rpm, perform five up‑and‑down strokes.

steps.title: Detergent solubilization of membranes
steps.instruction: Add ~350 mL solubilization buffer (recipe) to the homogenate, stir 300 rpm for 1 h at 4 °C; transfer supernatant to six 70 mL ultracentrifuge tubes, balance, ultracentrifuge 185,000 × g 1 h (Ti‑45 rotor), pool the clarified supernatant in a 500 mL beaker.

steps.title: Strep‑Tactin affinity capture
steps.instruction: Add 6 mL Strep‑Tactin resin pre‑equilibrated with solubilization buffer to the pooled supernatant, stir 200 rpm 60 min at 4 °C; harvest resin by centrifugation 2,500 × g 5 min in a 50 mL tube, split resin into two 25 mL gravity columns.

steps.title: Wash and elute GFP‑P2X7
steps.instruction: Wash each column with 20 mL washing buffer (recipe); elute bound protein with elution buffer (recipe) and collect the eluate.

steps.title: Concentrate eluate and measure protein
steps.instruction: Concentrate the eluate to 1 mL using a 100 kDa MWCO spin column, determine protein concentration by spectrophotometry.

steps.title: Thrombin cleavage of GFP tag
steps.instruction: Add thrombin to the concentrated protein at a 25:1 (w/w) ratio, incubate overnight (≈16 h) at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare SEC column and remove aggregates
steps.instruction: Equilibrate a Superdex 200 10/300 GL column with SEC buffer (recipe) using an FPLC system; centrifuge the thrombin‑digested sample at 264,360 × g 10 min, collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Size‑exclusion chromatography and collect peak
steps.instruction: Inject the cleared sample onto the equilibrated Superdex 200 column, run the column, and collect fractions corresponding to the main protein peak.
